name: Engineering & design
text: Product configurations, drawings and interoperability analysis — for a single shelter or an integrated turnkey camp — backed by an active R&D program.

name: Transportation & logistics

detail: Quick set-up and dismantle through prefabrication and quick-connect electrical, mechanical and furnishing components

name: Repair & overhaul
text: Inspection, a deficiency list, repairs to the maximum repair cost and return in the latest configuration, under Canada’s A-LM-184-00/JS-001.
detail: Inspection, then complete repair and overhaul to the latest standard
